subtasks.title: Inspect source and baseline
subtasks.instruction: Pin and inspect the repositories, refs, files, PRs, logs, databases or host evidence named by this task and its reuse notes. Record SHAs, timestamps and current state; do not modify inspected sources.
subtasks.deliverable: Evidence inventory with exact refs/SHAs, paths, current behavior and unknowns.
subtasks.done_when: Material claims trace to concrete sources and no inspected source was changed.

subtasks.title: Compare evidence to acceptance
subtasks.instruction: Compare inspected evidence with the parent objective and acceptance. Identify duplicates, conflicts, gaps, risks, platform constraints and relevant prior mistakes.
subtasks.deliverable: Findings matrix mapping every acceptance clause to evidence, gap or blocker.
subtasks.done_when: Every acceptance clause has a supported finding; assumptions are labelled.

subtasks.title: Record findings and decision
subtasks.instruction: Write a task-specific audit/decision record with findings, options, recommendation, rejected alternatives and evidence references.
subtasks.deliverable: Versioned report or decision record in approved docs path.
subtasks.done_when: Report is reproducible and distinguishes fact from inference.

subtasks.title: Independently cross-check evidence
subtasks.instruction: Independently re-check critical SHAs, paths, counts and conclusions; confirm no unrelated changes or sensitive data disclosure.
subtasks.deliverable: Review checklist and evidence receipt.
subtasks.done_when: Independent check agrees or unresolved differences keep parent blocked.

subtasks.done_when: Every module and external boundary has an owner, threat, control and test; active scans are restricted to inventoried owner-controlled targets.
